issues.description: The template's addGuestStudents method signature includes an extra boolean parameter (addGuestStudents(int, boolean)) while the problem specification and the solution expect addGuestStudents(int). This discrepancy will confuse students about which method to implement and may cause compilation/test failures or incorrect implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template method signature to match the specification and solution: replace public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput) with public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents). If input validation is desired, implement it inside the single-parameter method (e.g., by checking the parameter and handling invalid values), or provide an overload that clearly matches the UML and tests.
